artigo.titulo: Leggy, pale houseplant: is it lack of light?

legenda: Long bare stems and pale leaves are a plant reaching for light. Feeding won't fix it; more light, a turn of the pot and a trim will.

beats.texto: Leggy, pale pothos?! Feeding it won't fix it!
Relax! It's just reaching for light.
Long bare stems and pale leaves mean it's short of light.
And fertiliser in low light? It makes it even leggier.
Move it closer to the window, a little at a time.
More light dries the soil faster. Check it first.
Stretched stems won't shrink. Trim them above a leaf.
Every spot is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
